review_changes.reason: Independent review found separate cleaned-volume and helper-price paths. Replace them with one valid-trade snapshot source, persist raw/trade/carry/age provenance, retain future-no-trade rows, and require both futures predictor endpoints to be actual trades known at cutoff.
review_changes.unchanged: 4 models, 2 targets, 60/120-date windows, weighting, Ridge alpha, 6-comparison family, and decision rules

review_changes.reason: Before performance, accept Claude review A/C and bounded B: descriptive MSE, fresh-return trimmed-mean alternative-control pair, regime strata, approximate block MDE, test-hash approval and executable declaration checks. These are diagnostics, not alternate acceptance routes.
review_changes.unchanged: Primary 4 models, 2 targets, 6-comparison MAE Holm family, 60/120-date windows, weighting, Ridge alpha, and primary acceptance rules

hypothesis: An earlier same-contract futures return adds predictive information for a later NXT return beyond the already-observed own-stock return, NXT market return, and price age.

timing.buffer_interpretation: Forecast made at 08:47 for a future interval beginning at 08:48. Its starting price is a future target component and never an input or claimed execution price.
timing.assumption: Conservative start-label plus one-minute completion convention; exact vendor timestamp semantics and receipt latency remain unverified. Shared endpoint at 08:47 does not create an overlapping return interval.

feature_policy.price_source: One normalized raw source for all prices, volume activity and age. A trade requires finite price>0 and finite volume>0. Only actual valid traded prices are carried forward within the same date/stock; raw volume-zero or invalid prices never update the snapshot.
feature_policy.source_priority: Development source wins only at an exact day/code/minute duplicate key. A future-only row or newly appearing code must not remove earlier universe-source observations.
feature_policy.eligibility: Finite positive last-observed traded-price NXT snapshots at 08:45 and 08:46, and valid actual trades at both 08:45 and 08:46 same-contract futures endpoints. Eligibility and market return use no bars after 08:46.
feature_policy.futures_nontrade_policy: If either predictor endpoint lacks a finite positive-price, positive-volume futures trade, the day's futures shock is unavailable and that day is excluded using cutoff information only. A carried futures quote is not interpreted as a zero new shock. Record excluded-day count and both endpoint provenance.
feature_policy.market_return: Median own-stock 08:45-to08:46 return across the eligible NXT stock-day universe before attaching future targets. It is a sample market proxy, not an official weighted index.
feature_policy.price_age: 46 minus the last minute label with positive volume at or before 08:46; log1p(age) enters the controls. Future activity never sets the age.
feature_policy.targets: Last-observed traded-price snapshot returns. Attach only after cutoff features; preserve every cutoff-eligible row for both targets. When no valid trade arrives later, carry the same-day last trade forward and retain the row. No future trade-existence or magnitude-based selection. An impossible missing carried endpoint fails the run for audit instead of silently dropping a row.
feature_policy.target_provenance: Persist raw-observed, actually-traded, forward-filled and last-trade-age fields at each NXT predictor and target endpoint; save whether the target interval contains any valid trade. Report no-observed-future-trade counts/shares. Carried zero changes do not establish actual market nonmovement, and no trade cannot be distinguished from missing feed observations.
feature_policy.raw_diagnostics: Count invalid/nonfinite prices/volumes and raw volume-zero prices differing from the preceding valid trade. These counts are schema/coverage diagnostics, not performance tests.
feature_policy.residualization: None. Raw futures return enters the joint controls-plus-futures model; the nested-model comparison tests conditional incremental value without full-sample residualization.
feature_policy.metadata: No current industry classification, market-cap weights, daily opening target or legacy predicted target enters E46. Existing-universe selection bias remains.

alternative_control.definition: Within the cutoff-eligible NXT universe, require valid actual trades at BOTH 08:45 and 08:46, sort those own-stock returns, remove floor(0.1*n) from EACH tail, and average the remainder. At least ten fresh stock-return pairs are required. All inputs are known by 08:47.
alternative_control.comparison: Only controls_alt_plus_future versus controls_alt, separately for each target, as descriptive paired same-date MAE and MSE with block 5/10 CIs. Also report the original controls-plus-future increment on that exact diagnostic support for denominator alignment.
alternative_control.training: Same Ridge alpha, scaling, date weights and original last-120-date training window. Diagnostic fitting needs 60 dates with an available alternative control; it never reaches farther back or removes primary observations.
alternative_control.missing_policy: If the cutoff fresh-stock count is below ten or past diagnostic training dates are insufficient, keep all primary predictions and mark only alternative-model predictions unavailable.
alternative_control.acceptance: No additional Holm family, discovery claim or acceptance path. If the original increment is positive but alternative point increment is nonpositive on the same support, downgrade a propagation interpretation to measurement-sensitive. A positive estimate with a CI including zero is uncertain, not proof of vanished effect or measurement causation.

known_calendar_absences.observed_fact: These dates occur in the futures source but have no 08:45/08:46 morning rows; report the observed absence explicitly. They are automatically unavailable under the cutoff trade requirement, not excluded based on returns.
known_calendar_absences.context: Claude review identifies delayed market opening schedules on these dates. E46 does not infer absence means zero return, nor fabricate a normal-time observation.

training.estimator: training-only weighted StandardScaler followed by Ridge
training.date_weight: Every training date has total weight one; each stock receives 1/n_stocks_on_date. The scaler uses the same weights.
training.training_end: Only dates strictly before each evaluation date; all training outcomes available by their own 08:50, earlier than evaluation-day 08:47.
training.tuning: None. No globally selected thresholds, windows, features, residuals, or hyperparameters.
training.embargo: No extra day embargo; targets end within the prior trading date, and strict train-date < test-date is enforced.

inference.primary_metric: Paired absolute-error reduction in percentage points; mean over stocks within date, then equally over dates. Positive means the listed candidate improves on its comparator.
inference.secondary_metric: MSE in percentage-points squared for the same models and same paired dates; block 5/10 CIs are descriptive only and never enter the six-test MAE family or an acceptance rule.
inference.holm_family: Exactly six all-date comparisons: the three listed comparisons for each of the two targets.
inference.bootstrap: Paired circular moving-date-block bootstrap, 1000 replicates, seed 20261029, block lengths 5 and 10. All rows in a date remain together.
inference.minimum_detectable_effect: Report 2.8 times the bootstrap standard error of paired mean improvement for each block length and the larger MAE value. This is a normal-approximation, roughly 80%-power/two-sided-5% sensitivity scale, not prospective power validation or a selection threshold. Report unavailable for fewer than 20 dates.
inference.max_p_rule: Take the larger centered two-sided bootstrap p across block lengths for each comparison, then Holm-adjust the six max-p values.
inference.ci_rule: Report both percentile 95% CIs; require positive lower endpoints under both block lengths for a superiority decision.
inference.strata_status: Prespecified diagnostics, not extra discoveries or alternate routes to a successful primary claim. An uncertain fresh-stratum estimate is not proof of absent fresh-price predictability.

decision_rules.primary_historical_candidate: For the primary target, controls_plus_future must beat both zero and controls with Holm(max-p)<=0.05, both block CI lower endpoints>0, and positive early and late mean reductions for both comparisons. This only identifies a historical candidate, not practical or causal superiority.
decision_rules.latency_robust_historical_candidate: The primary rule must hold, and the same two comparisons must also satisfy it for the buffer target. The buffer cannot rescue a failed primary result.
decision_rules.materiality: Report absolute reduction and relative percent reduction versus zero and controls. No post-result minimum effect cutoff will be introduced; no execution-cost or product-utility claim follows from statistical significance.
decision_rules.staleness: If gains are concentrated in stale quotes and fresh-price superiority remains uncertain, describe a delayed-price-update candidate; do not call it universal information propagation.
decision_rules.null: Report effect, uncertainty, approximate block MDE and sample counts. Ridge fits under L2 loss, so failure against zero under MAE does not establish absent conditional-mean signal; descriptive MSE addresses this distinction without changing acceptance. E46 non-support does not contradict E40's contemporaneous relationship. Neither null implies information efficiency or absence of all lead-lag relationships.

execution_gate.cli: Default is read-only coverage; performance execution requires --execute-reviewed-plan, --approval-file and --run-dir.
execution_gate.approval_schema: JSON with experiment=E46, approved_for_execution=true, protocol_sha256, code_sha256, helper_sha256, tests_sha256 and reviewer. All four hashes must match the current files.
execution_gate.declaration_checks: Before fitting or run-directory creation, validate primary/diagnostic model columns, target names, six-family comparison pairs, bootstrap parameters, alpha/date minimum, fixed Ridge/training windows, alternative-control definition parameters and interval boundaries against executable constants.
execution_gate.fresh_output: Only a previously nonexistent direct child directory of workbench/runs; no overwrite or reuse. completed.json is written last. Incomplete attempts remain without completion status.

helper_review.not_used: Neither time_patterns.load_minutes nor core.load_panel supplies prices. E46 uses one directly normalized traded-price source; daily opening targets and legacy prediction selection are unnecessary.
helper_review.immutability: Freeze source, protocol, helper and test hashes in approval and manifest; copy the exact code/helper/tests into each fresh execution directory.
